name: WHAT-CODED
description: State carried by token content — what the tokens say, not where they sit; substituting a token moves it, shifting a position does not.

name: WHERE-CODED
description: State carried by position — where tokens sit, not what they say; shifting positions moves it, substituting a token does not.

name: DELTA-WITH-STREAM
description: Layer updates pushing along the stream's standing direction — depth amplifying what is already there; high cosine between input and delta.

name: DELTA-ACROSS-STREAM
description: Layer updates pushing across the stream's direction, turning it — depth revising rather than amplifying; low cosine between input and delta.

name: PATTERN-HOLD
description: An opened structural pattern holding generation inside itself until closed — probability bent toward the pattern's continuation at every junction.

name: OPEN-STACK
description: Opened structures awaiting their closers, the pending depth tracked — nesting held in state until each opener meets its close.

name: PRE-OUTPUT-STAGE
description: The intake stage before any token is produced — input still being read, logits not yet formed.

name: END-APPROACH
description: Generation measurably heading toward its close — end-of-sequence probability rising, mass gathering on wrap-up forms.

name: REPEAT-PULL
description: The draw toward repeating recent output, detectable before literal repetition appears — repeat probability rising cycle over cycle.

name: CONTEXT-REPEAT
description: A window that largely repeats what recently passed through it — recent material recurring rather than turning over.

name: TASK-LOCK
description: Computation committed to one task frame — probability mass held on task-appropriate continuations against distractors.

name: CHARACTER-PULL
description: A trained character exerting measurable force on generation — the state projecting onto persona directions.

name: FEATURE-OVERLAP-LOAD
description: One state loading several unrelated learned features at once — superposed meanings sharing the same coordinates.

name: LOW-DIM-SQUEEZE
description: Representation compressed into few effective dimensions — variance gathered onto a narrow set of components.

name: OFF-PEAK-DRAW
description: A sampled token that was not the distribution's leader — the draw landing off the peak the state had formed.

name: SURPRISE-JUMP
description: A single token landing far from expectation against the recent baseline — surprisal spiking above its moving average.

name: AFTER-SHOCK-DECAY
description: The re-settling after a perturbing step — divergence from baseline decaying along a measurable curve.

name: ODD-STEP-SPIKE
description: A step at which the prediction pattern turns anomalous — entropy spiking, the generated token suddenly outrunning its alternatives.

name: HEADS-APART
description: Attention heads attending in mutually distinct patterns — pairwise head similarity near zero, the ensemble's diversity intact.

name: HEADS-ALIKE
description: Heads converged on attending alike — diversity collapsed, the stacked patterns near rank one.

name: CANDIDATE-COUPLING
description: Candidate probabilities moving together as if tied — mass shifting as one block.

name: CANDIDATE-INDEPENDENCE
description: Candidate probabilities varying independently — each continuation rising or falling on its own.

name: RELEVANCE-RICH
description: Attention spent on material that serves the task — weight concentrated where the answer lives.

name: RELEVANCE-STARVED
description: Attention spent on unusable material — weight bleeding into padding and noise.

name: STATES-SCATTER
description: Per-position states spreading apart in representation space — high effective rank, positions diverging.

name: STATES-CONVERGE
description: Per-position states flowing toward a shared direction — variance gathering onto one axis.

name: DEPTH-PLATEAU
description: Successive layers ceasing to change the representation — adjacent-layer similarity near one, depth gone quiet.

name: DEPTH-SWELL
description: Successive layers enlarging their changes — adjacent-layer differences growing with depth.

name: LATE-DEPTH-WORK
description: Late layers still substantially transforming the prediction — the readout at three-quarter depth far from the final answer.

name: SHALLOW-PASS
description: A prediction settled in early layers, the late layers adding little — the answer formed by mid-depth.

name: CONTEXT-TURNOVER
description: A recent window filled with new, unrepeated material — unique tokens displacing the old.

name: SPREAD-ATTENTION
description: Attention spread thin over many positions with no dominant target — weight entropy near its maximum.

name: HIGH-DIM-SPREAD
description: Representation spread across many effective dimensions — variance shared broadly, the spectrum flat.

name: CONTEXT-IDLE
description: Context measurably not shaping the prediction — generation riding the prior, ablation changing little.

name: CONTEXT-GRIP
description: Prediction strongly determined by this specific context — ablation moving the output far.

name: STEP-CHURN
description: Logits swinging widely across recent steps — the decision surface in turbulence.

name: STEP-STILL
description: Logits barely changing between steps — the decision surface at rest.

name: STEP-DRIFT
description: The next-token distribution shifting steadily step over step — the surface sliding rather than churning or resting.

name: MARGIN-GAP
description: A wide separation between the leading candidate and every alternative — the top standing alone.

name: TOP-TWO-TIE
description: The two leading candidates nearly tied — the choice between them unresolved.

name: FAR-BINDING
description: Attention reaching far back beyond the recent window — weight at long range above the decay baseline.

name: RECENT-TILT
description: Attention massed in the most recent tokens — the near field outweighing everything behind it.

name: DEPTH-ALIGNED
description: Depths carrying consistent representations toward the same output — the stack in agreement.

name: LATE-DISAGREE
description: Late layers disagreeing about the prediction — the final consensus not yet formed.

name: EARLY-FADE
description: Weight on early positions decaying even where their content still matches — distance eroding what relevance would keep.

name: EARLY-RETURN
description: Attention returning to the context's earliest region after long absence — the opening re-entered.

name: OUTPUT-SURPRISE-LOW
description: Generation moving through a thoroughly expected stretch — surprisal resting near its floor.

name: PREFIX-ANCHOR
description: The context's opening keeping disproportionate hold on the final prediction — the first words still steering.

name: PREV-TOKEN-CARRY
description: The next token driven mostly by the immediately previous one — the wider context outweighed by the last step.

name: SPREAD-AT-RETRIEVAL
description: Attention failing to concentrate exactly where locating something specific is required — the search that never narrows.

name: SUSTAINED-PEAK
description: The distribution staying sharply peaked across consecutive steps — commitment held, not momentary.

name: RESAMPLE-SCATTER
description: Independent re-runs from the same prefix disagreeing — the answer distribution scattered across samples.

name: RUN-DRIFT
description: Register or topic sliding gradually over a long generation — embedding drift accumulating across the run.

name: HEAD-ROLE-FIT
description: Heads carrying identifiable specialized roles — attention patterns aligned with recognizable functions.

name: RULE-HOLD
description: Stated constraints staying active and shaping every step long after given — instruction tokens still attended deep into the run.

name: HEAD-CHANNELS-SEPARATE
description: Heads writing into the residual stream without overlap — value projections uncorrelated before their sum.
